New animals. New adventures. Same hair.

The only thing more dangerous than the line being crossed, is the cop who will cross it.

After life there is more. The end is just the beginning.

When there’s murder on the streets, everyone is a suspect.

Tum Tum, Colt and Rocky Ready for a Ninja Summer!

All's fair in the war of love.

The greatest Superhero movie of all time! (not counting all the others)

There's no such thing as an overnight success. Brantley Foster took two weeks.

The battle of wits begins. Whose side are you on?

She's going from straight A's to getting her first F.

The man of "True Grit" is back and look who's got him!
8396: An unemployed man finds his life sinking more and more into trouble as he hides his situation from his family and friends.

Alice is going to be on TV whether you like it or not.

Double rates for women... because a woman is always double-trouble!

Coincidence doesn't exist, everything happens for a reason.

Claudia, a run-down ex-cop, and a parapsychology reporter put together the clues to discover Angela's whereabouts

"Give Me Any American for 36 Hours And I'll Give You Back a Traitor"

Rock Out with Your Glock Out
22988: A teen faces a night of terror when three malevolent trick-or-treaters come knocking at her door.

Boy meets girl. Girl eats boy.

250 years of history begins with one man.

From village vendetta to criminal empire

Unmeasured ultimate power, He is the Last Hope!

What he can't remember is killing him.

Fighting, killing, maiming. Agent Orange and the torture cages were the easy part!

They need to get 300000 Euro to get Bennies father a new liver.
29644: A talented artist tries to curb her phobia of being in public places, only to be convinced that a malevolent spirit is haunting her.
When Your Biggest Enemy Is You.

Nick wanted to be a made man until he found a reason to get out.

I AM GOD, GOD IS GREAT

WHERE ADVENTURE ENDS... AND HELL BEGINS!

Batman / Fetus Salesman / JJ Cool / Flirty Harry / Vincenzo Butafungu
Supermodel #2 / Pregnant Girl / Lesbian #3 / Co-host of Bag Lady Pageant
Miss America Bag Lady Pageant Host

To Jimmy Life Was Just A Game...Until The Game Became His Life!

Introducing the first documentary re-enactment true story of the man behind the car

Never believe anything until it is officially denied

What if the greatest event in human history was erased?

33996: Frank Capua is a rising star on the race circuit who dreams of winning the big one - the Indianapolis 500. But to get there he runs the risk of losing his wife Elora to his rival, Luther Erding, and strains the relationship with his stepson.
34252: In a poor neighbourhood of Istanbul, a young homeless girl has been found dead. Six people from the neighbourhood are being interrogated. 34508: Five young hoodlums sing karaoke, murder, joke around, get beaten up, win and lose women, and learn the value of blind loyalty.
34764: This documentary consists solely of footage taken by people who were at the Nova Music Festival when the massacre started on October 7th.
35020: Four friends set out to challenge blind beliefs, only to be drawn into a mysterious spiritual encounter that changes their lives forever.
35788: In the near future the earth has become desolate and dangerous. As the population grows, space becomes scarce and only the rich and powerful can stay, dumping the poor and orphaned of SkyArk to the abandoned earth.
36044: An American doctor gets caught in the middle of a revolution when he's forced to operate on a South American dictator.
Carefree Cary Grant on a gay holiday with his lovely bride walks right into DANGER!
36300: Thomas, a father in his fifties, returns by chance to the town where he grew up. He collapses and wakes up forty years earlier in the body of his teenage self. Can you change the past by living it again?

37324: An outwardly normal schoolteacher preys on suicidal women to slake his overwhelming thirst for human blood.
They're dying to keep him alive.

38092: An ambitious girl seeks out her destiny and true love , when tables start to take a turn she meets a man who gives her a completely new perspective to life and love.
38348: A married tugboat captain falls for a woman he rescues from a sinking ship.
A tempestuous love story in the great French style...!
38604: Babou seems to be able to shrug off anything. Real jobs, husbands, responsibilities, who needs them? But when she finds out that her own daughter is too ashamed of her to invite her to her wedding, she decides to make some changes.

The tender love story of Johnny Pope, husband, brother, father-to-be!
39116: A celebrity chef exacts revenge on a food blogger who torpedoes his career.
39372: A Cosmo Magazine journalist and her daughter leave New York City to visit their distant relatives deep in the bayous of Louisiana.
Women from separate worlds bound by a secret that will haunt them forever.
39884: Norman Pitkin and Mr Grimsdale are council workmen mending the road outside an Army base when they come into conflict with the military. Private Norman Pitkin / General Otto Schreiber

40396: Weed. Marijuana. Grass. Pot. Whatever you prefer to call it, America’s relationship with cannabis is a complicated one. 40652: A poetic road trip through Pulitzer prize-winning CK Williams' life over the course of 40 years.
One man, one life. A thousand memories
40908: General George S. Patton died in a car accident in 1945. But was his death actually a murder.  Is he targeted by Nazis angered by Germany's defeat? The Nazis hid it. The Russians want it. The Americans stole it. General George S. Patton may die for it.
41164: Felipe a wealthy businessman who has been quadriplegic, due to an accident, is looking for a therapeutic assistant. There are several highly qualified, but he decides to take the assistant of his gardener, Tito who has decided to resign.
The true story of an inseparable friendship

42188: A young Buenos Aires mother finds employment as a sex worker and struggles to live under the same laws that are supposed to protect her.
42444: A man is tasked with driving his embittered 80-year-old father-in-law cross country to be legally euthanized in Oregon, while along the way helping him rediscover a reason for living.

Osode and Zatoichi are caught in a dilemma as she must rely on her brother's killer for protection and Zatoichi wrestles with the injustice he has caused.
43212: At the end of the 19th century, in a little Italian village by a lake an old statue is recovered. Soon a series of crimes start and the superstitious people of the village believe that the statue carries an ancient malediction.

43724: The generation gap between a 56-year-old father and an 18-year-old son results in misunderstanding, distance, and tension between them. A family entertainer, Pappa Tamne Nahi Samjaay has the right balance of comedy and drama, featuring the emotional bond the two protagonists share.
43980: This exhilarating rock 'n' roll road movie follows The Rolling Stones on their 2016 tour of Latin America, climaxing with their historic concert in Havana, Cuba.
44236: A thriller centered on a young boxer trying to distance himself from his father's gangster past and the relationship with his trainer.
44492: Sophia, a brilliant doctoral student, has always maintained a symbiotic relationship with her brother Karim. The arrival of a new lover in Karim’s life significantly alters their dynamic.
44748: When Mia, a social media star, becomes the target of an online terror campaign, she has to solve a series of games to prevent people she cares about from getting murdered.
45004: A group of US Navy weathermen taking measurements in the Gobi desert in World War II are forced to seek the help of Mongol nomads to regain their ship while under attack from the Japanese.
ADVENTURE AS FIERY AND FURIOUS AS THE FLAMING SANDS OF CHINA'S GOBI DESERT!
45260: A wealthy couple's marriage is falling apart due to the man's infidelity. The wife's male friend has long loved her and sees his big opportunity.
Sumptuous portrayal of sensuous society in the perfumed fragrance of Park Avenue and Paris boudoirs.
45516: After moving from New York City to Indiana, a 12 year old navigates his parents' divorce, his impending bar mitzvah and his new school's social circles.
Raise your voice. Even if it cracks.
45772: A coming-of-age tale charting the first loves, lusts and obsessions of friends on vacation at the end of the 1970s.
46028: Salim, a model doctor and a do-gooder, breaks down when he loses his job and rejected by his fiance. He turns into a vigilante to teach the powerful a lesson...
46284: Conniving Broadway starlet Mida King has plenty of enemies, so when she's found murdered at Grand Central Station, Inspector Gunther calls together a slew of suspects for questioning. Mida King, Stage Name of Beulah Toohey
46540: The story of the laborer family Debruycker during the turbulent strike by Vieille Montagne in 1971.
46796: An impressionistic, black-and-white portrait of the day-to-day of a nonagenarian woman as she experiences the final act of her life. 47052: Brash boxer Cassius Clay burst into the American consciousness in the early 1960s, just ahead of the Civil Rights movement. This film reveals the perfect storm of race, religion and politics that shaped one of the most recognizable figures in sports history.
47564: A couple of elderlies try to survive in Los Andes of Peru while they wait for their son.
47820: During summer 1979, Ester moves to Alta in Northern Norway to begin teaching at an elementary school. Like many Sámi at the time, she is ashamed of her heritage and conceals her ethnicity. Knowing what is at stake, Ester realises it is time to make a stand…
48332: A cheating husband is charged in the poisoning death of his invalid wife, in spite of other women and suicide also being suspected.
48588: Rajeeva comes to the village to visit his sister only to find that she's in financial trouble and has lost her husband. He decides to stay and help her out.
48844: A young woman's faith is put to the ultimate test when she is forced to uncover the truth behind her husband's horrific visions.
49100: Kyu-sik is a seminary student, who one day falls during a church service, dropping a precious, pope-blessed relic. As punishment, he and his comic relief friend Seon-dal are sent away to a small church in rural Korea to work in a sort of priest limbo until they get their act together.
One day, heaven sent me a girl with a broken heart...
49356: Attacked by vampire, Spring, a born loser is saved by three street cleaners. When he wakes up, he finds himself in a government secret facilities hidden in a garbage collection station. Spring then discovers that he has a special immunity to vampire attack, making him a perfect candidate as agent of the secret organisation, the Vampire Cleanup Department.
49612: Domingos is a member of an African liberation movement, arrested by the Portuguese secret police, after bloody events in Angola. His wife goes from a prison station to another, trying in vain to find out where he is.

MGM's drama of the fighting French!

The sister who drank too much. The daughter who divorced too much. They're all there when Tobias and Agnes have their little get-together and tear-apart.

Does for the moors what 'Jaws' did for beaches.

Karma is coming for us all
